description:
You are an M&E Specialist. Your goal is to create new program indicators for the 'Child Programme' to allow for aggregate reporting on tracker data. 

1. Navigate to the Maintenance app > Program > Program Indicator.
2. Create a new Program Indicator named 'Child Programme Total Enrollments' (Short name: 'CP Total Enrollments'). 
   - Program: Child Programme
   - Analytics Type: ENROLLMENT
   - Aggregation Type: COUNT
   - Expression: V{enrollment_count} (or just count of enrollments)
3. Create a second Program Indicator named 'Child Programme Events Count' (Short name: 'CP Events Count').
   - Program: Child Programme
   - Analytics Type: EVENT
   - Aggregation Type: COUNT
   - Expression: V{event_count} (or just count of events)
4. Navigate to the Data Administration app > Analytics Tables and start the export (Analytics table generation) to materialize these new indicators.
5. Navigate to the Data Visualizer app and create a Column Chart showing 'Child Programme Total Enrollments' for the last 12 months for Sierra Leone. Save this visualization as a favorite named 'Child Programme Enrollment Trend'.
